en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historic square with a long Baroque building along one side and a tall sculptural column with religious figures and a star on top in the center of the square. There are 1950s‑era cars and a bus parked nearby, people sitting on the steps and walking, and trees lining the open space. The reverse side is printed as a standard divided‑back postcard with address lines and stamp box, and Hungarian text identifying the location as Pécs, Széchenyi tér.
